title: Helstrom (Black Marsh & Valenwood)

parts.name: landing
parts.notes: dock5: the jetties, the Breton caravel (interior 01Ship, exit 01Exit2) and BM&V's Helstrom map marker

parts.name: town
parts.notes: stronghold domes and dwellings on bridges and stilts; nine house doors (all to 01ArgonianHouseinside), the hall (01cellDUPLICATE002)

parts.name: camp
parts.notes: the guard camp north of the town: tents, beds, soldiers and a servant from Black Marsh North.esp, the jail cave (01BlackRoseJail)

notes: Measured from the plugins (the built area: buildings, doors, furniture, containers, actors): 389 m east-west by 867 m north-south in all, the landing and the town 389 m by 690 m. The landing (dock5, centre (-38371,54402)) lies 331 m south-south-west (bearing 198 degrees) of the town's centre (-31092,76391); its jetties end where the town's first houses start, so they are one settlement along the river. The guard camp lies 285 m north of the town's centre. Interiors are followed through doors, never into another settlement; temple2 (-10,25) is only a cell name inside the camp's cells.
